Population increased in Flintshire

The estimated population of Flintshire in 2024 was 155,867 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Flintshire's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Flintshire increased by 0.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Flintshire was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Flintshire

The average (median) age stayed at 44.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Flintshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Flintshire is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Flintshire's population of 155,867 usual residents was made up of:

  • 26,833 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.2%)
  • 94,582 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.7%)
  • 34,452 people aged 65 years and over, (22.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Flintshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Flintshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Flintshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Flintshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 295 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 1,380 births and 1,675 deaths in Flintshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 490 (0.3%). There were 5,455 people entering the area and 4,965 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Flintshire's population of 70 (0%) as a result of 484 people entering the area and 414 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Flintshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Flintshire in mid-2023 is 155,614.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 185 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 383 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 198 people.
